name: Windrose Dedicated Server (Steam dedicated server + Wine)
author: community@local
description: Installs the Windrose Dedicated Server (Steam AppID 4129620) via authenticated SteamCMD and runs StartServerForeground.bat under Wine on Linux. Players join via InviteCode.
startup: bash -lc 'cd /home/container || exit 1; export WINEPREFIX=/home/container/.wine; if [[ ! -f .wine_prereqs_done ]]; then if [[ ! -x ./winetricks ]]; then echo "Downloading winetricks..."; curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Winetricks/winetricks/master/src/winetricks -o ./winetricks && chmod +x ./winetricks; fi; if [[ -x ./winetricks ]]; then echo "Running winetricks vcrun2022..."; if command -v xvfb-run >/dev/null 2>&1; then WINEDEBUG=-all xvfb-run -a ./winetricks -q vcrun2022; else WINEDEBUG=-all ./winetricks -q vcrun2022; fi; if [[ $? -eq 0 ]]; then touch .wine_prereqs_done; echo "VC++ runtime installed."; else echo "winetricks failed; continuing anyway."; fi; else echo "winetricks unavailable; skipping."; fi; fi; if [[ ! -x ./start-windrose.sh ]]; then echo "start-windrose.sh missing; reinstall the server."; exit 1; fi; exec ./start-windrose.sh'

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /mnt/server

# 1) Always (re)write start-windrose.sh FIRST so a SteamCMD failure doesn't
#    leave the next boot without a launcher.
cat > /mnt/server/start-windrose.sh <<'SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /home/container
export WINEDEBUG="${WINEDEBUG:--all}"
export STEAM_APPID="${STEAM_APPID:-4129620}"
export SteamAppId="$STEAM_APPID"
export SteamGameId="$STEAM_APPID"

# Find the launch target. Prefer the official foreground batch file so
# Windrose starts with the same wrapper the dedicated server package ships.
START_BAT=""
for cand in   "./R5/Builds/WindowsServer/StartServerForeground.bat"   "./R5/Builds/WindroseServer/StartServerForeground.bat"   "./StartServerForeground.bat"   "./R5/StartServerForeground.bat"; do
  if [[ -f "$cand" ]]; then
    START_BAT="$cand"
    break
  fi
done

# Fall back to a direct executable launch only if the foreground batch file
# is missing.
SERVER_EXE=""
if [[ -z "$START_BAT" ]]; then
  for cand in     "./R5/Builds/WindowsServer/WindroseServer.exe"     "./R5/Builds/WindroseServer/WindroseServer.exe"     "./WindroseServer.exe"     "./R5/WindroseServer.exe"     "./R5/Builds/WindowsServer/R5/Binaries/Win64/WindroseServer-Win64-Shipping.exe"     "./R5/Builds/WindroseServer/R5/Binaries/Win64/WindroseServer-Win64-Shipping.exe"     "./R5/Binaries/Win64/WindroseServer-Win64-Shipping.exe"; do
    if [[ -f "$cand" ]]; then
      SERVER_EXE="$cand"
      break
    fi
  done
fi

if [[ -z "$SERVER_EXE" && -z "$START_BAT" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: neither WindroseServer.exe nor StartServerForeground.bat found."
  echo "Searching recursively..."
  find . -maxdepth 6 -type f \( -iname "WindroseServer.exe" -o -iname "WindroseServer-Win64-Shipping.exe" -o -iname "StartServerForeground.bat" \) -print || true
  exit 1
fi

# Resolve absolute path + server directory BEFORE cd-ing so paths stay valid.
if [[ -n "$SERVER_EXE" ]]; then
  SERVER_ABS="$(cd "$(dirname "$SERVER_EXE")" && pwd)/$(basename "$SERVER_EXE")"
else
  SERVER_ABS="$(cd "$(dirname "$START_BAT")" && pwd)/$(basename "$START_BAT")"
fi
SERVER_DIR="$(dirname "$SERVER_ABS")"
SERVER_NAMEONLY="$(basename "$SERVER_ABS")"

echo "Server root:  $SERVER_DIR"
echo "Launch target: $SERVER_NAMEONLY"

# cd into the server bundle so UE5 discovers Content/Paks and writes logs
# to the expected Saved/Logs/ path.
cd "$SERVER_DIR"
printf "%s\n" "${STEAM_APPID:-4129620}" > steam_appid.txt

# The shipped foreground batch currently uses Windows `start`, which detaches
# and makes Wine/Pelican think the server exited. Rewrite it to run in the
# current process and pass through Pelican's port arguments.
if [[ -n "$START_BAT" && -f "$SERVER_NAMEONLY" ]]; then
  cat > "$SERVER_NAMEONLY" <<'BAT'
@echo off
pushd %~dp0%
WindroseServer.exe -log %*
popd
BAT
fi

# Seed/patch ServerDescription.json *inside the server root*, which is the
# file the server actually reads and rewrites.
if [[ ! -f "ServerDescription.json" ]]; then
  cat > "ServerDescription.json" <<'JSON'
{
  "Version": 1,
  "DeploymentId": "",
  "ServerDescription_Persistent": {
    "PersistentServerId": "",
    "InviteCode": "MyServer1",
    "IsPasswordProtected": false,
    "Password": "",
    "ServerName": "Windrose Dedicated Server",
    "WorldIslandId": "",
    "MaxPlayerCount": 4,
    "P2pProxyAddress": ""
  }
}
JSON
fi

if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import os

path = "ServerDescription.json"
with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fp:
    data = json.load(fp)

persist = data.get("ServerDescription_Persistent")
target = persist if isinstance(persist, dict) else data

def read_env(name, default=None):
    value = os.environ.get(name)
    return default if value is None else value

invite = read_env("INVITE_CODE", target.get("InviteCode", "MyServer1"))
server_name = read_env("SERVER_NAME", target.get("ServerName", "Windrose Dedicated Server"))
max_players = read_env("MAX_PLAYERS", target.get("MaxPlayerCount", 4))
proxy = read_env("P2P_PROXY_ADDRESS", target.get("P2pProxyAddress", ""))
password_mode = str(read_env("PASSWORD_PROTECTED", target.get("IsPasswordProtected", False))).strip().lower()
password_enabled = password_mode in {"1", "true", "yes", "y", "on"}
password = read_env("SERVER_PASSWORD", target.get("Password", ""))

target["InviteCode"] = invite
target["ServerName"] = server_name
try:
    target["MaxPlayerCount"] = int(max_players)
except Exception:
    pass
target["P2pProxyAddress"] = proxy
target["IsPasswordProtected"] = bool(password_enabled)
target["Password"] = password if password_enabled else ""

with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fp:
    json.dump(data, fp, indent=2)
    fp.write("\n")
PY
else
  echo "WARNING: python3 not found; skipping ServerDescription.json env patching"
fi

# Mirror ServerDescription.json up to /home/container so it is discoverable
# via SFTP at the server root too (read-only informational copy).
cp -f "ServerDescription.json" "/home/container/ServerDescription.json" || true

EXTRA_ARGS=()
if [[ -n "${BIND_IP:-}" ]]; then
  EXTRA_ARGS+=("-MULTIHOME=${BIND_IP}")
fi
if [[ -n "${GAME_PORT:-}" ]]; then
  EXTRA_ARGS+=("-PORT=${GAME_PORT}")
fi
if [[ -n "${QUERY_PORT:-}" ]]; then
  EXTRA_ARGS+=("-QUERYPORT=${QUERY_PORT}")
fi

if [[ -n "$SERVER_EXE" ]]; then
  echo "Launching (direct exe from $SERVER_DIR): ./$SERVER_NAMEONLY ${EXTRA_ARGS[*]}"
  LAUNCH=(wine "./$SERVER_NAMEONLY")
else
  echo "--- ./$SERVER_NAMEONLY contents: ---"
  cat "./$SERVER_NAMEONLY" || true
  echo "--- end ./$SERVER_NAMEONLY ---"
  echo "Launching (via .bat from $SERVER_DIR): ./$SERVER_NAMEONLY ${EXTRA_ARGS[*]}"
  LAUNCH=(wine cmd /c "./$SERVER_NAMEONLY")
fi

if command -v xvfb-run >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  exec xvfb-run -a "${LAUNCH[@]}" "${EXTRA_ARGS[@]}"
else
  exec "${LAUNCH[@]}" "${EXTRA_ARGS[@]}"
fi
SH
chmod +x /mnt/server/start-windrose.sh

# 2) Fetch SteamCMD if missing.
if [[ ! -x "./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh" ]]; then
  mkdir -p steamcmd
  echo "Downloading SteamCMD..."
  curl -sSL "https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz" | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi

# 3) Wipe any stale/partial appmanifest so a prior failed run doesn't keep
#    producing 'Missing configuration' on +app_update validate.
rm -f "/mnt/server/steamapps/appmanifest_3041230.acf" || true
rm -f "/mnt/server/steamapps/appmanifest_4129620.acf" || true
rm -f "/mnt/server/steamapps/appmanifest_${STEAM_APPID:-4129620}.acf" || true

# 4) Require credentials for SteamCMD install/update. Some Windrose server installs require account login even for the dedicated server app.
if [[ -z "${STEAM_USER:-}" || -z "${STEAM_PASS:-}" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: STEAM_USER and STEAM_PASS must be set on the server's Startup tab."
  echo "       Use a Steam account that can access the Windrose Dedicated Server (AppID ${STEAM_APPID:-4129620})."
  echo "       If the account has Steam Guard enabled, also set STEAM_GUARD on the"
  echo "       first install only; SteamCMD caches the machine token afterwards."
  exit 1
fi

LOGIN_ARGS=(+login "${STEAM_USER}" "${STEAM_PASS}")
if [[ -n "${STEAM_GUARD:-}" ]]; then
  LOGIN_ARGS+=("${STEAM_GUARD}")
fi

# 5) Run SteamCMD. +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType MUST come *after* +login
#    because +login resets the platform type back to the host OS.
./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh \
  +@NoPromptForPassword 1 \
  +force_install_dir /mnt/server \
  "${LOGIN_ARGS[@]}" \
  +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows \
  +app_info_update 1 \
  +app_update "${STEAM_APPID:-4129620}" validate \
  +quit

# 6) Flatten any nested installdir (some SteamCMD builds nest by app name).
if [[ -d "/mnt/server/Windrose" ]] && compgen -G "/mnt/server/Windrose/*" > /dev/null; then
  echo "Detected nested installdir folder; flattening..."
  shopt -s dotglob
  mv "/mnt/server/Windrose"/* /mnt/server/ || true
  rmdir "/mnt/server/Windrose" || true
fi

# 7) Seed a default ServerDescription.json inside the server bundle if one
#    isn't already there (install scripts should not clobber an existing one).
SEED_DIR=""
for cand in \
  "/mnt/server/R5/Builds/WindowsServer" \
  "/mnt/server/R5/Builds/WindroseServer"; do
  if [[ -d "$cand" ]]; then
    SEED_DIR="$cand"
    break
  fi
done

if [[ -n "$SEED_DIR" && ! -f "$SEED_DIR/ServerDescription.json" ]]; then
  cat > "$SEED_DIR/ServerDescription.json" <<'JSON'
{
  "Version": 1,
  "DeploymentId": "",
  "ServerDescription_Persistent": {
    "PersistentServerId": "",
    "InviteCode": "MyServer1",
    "IsPasswordProtected": false,
    "Password": "",
    "ServerName": "Windrose Dedicated Server",
    "WorldIslandId": "",
    "MaxPlayerCount": 4,
    "P2pProxyAddress": ""
  }
}
JSON
fi

echo "Install complete. Start script at /home/container/start-windrose.sh"

variables.name: Steam Username
variables.description: Steam username used by SteamCMD during install/update.

variables.name: Steam Password
variables.description: Steam password used by SteamCMD during install/update.

variables.name: Steam Guard Code (first install only)
variables.description: Current Steam Guard code for first install/login only; clear after SteamCMD caches the machine token.

variables.name: Invite Code
variables.description: Players join via this InviteCode (min 6 chars; case-sensitive).

variables.name: Password Protected
variables.description: true/false — require a password to join.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password required if Password Protected is true.

variables.name: P2P Proxy Address
variables.description: P2pProxyAddress value in ServerDescription.json; usually blank.

variables.name: Game Port (optional)
variables.description: Optional -PORT argument. Windrose typically uses UDP 7777; leave blank to use defaults.

variables.name: Query Port (optional)
variables.description: Optional -QUERYPORT argument. Windrose typically uses UDP 7778; leave blank to use defaults.

variables.name: Wine Debug
variables.description: Wine debug output control. Default '-all' reduces spam; set to 'warn+all,err+all' to debug startup failures.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Windrose Dedicated Server Steam app ID. Do not change unless the dedicated server app ID changes.
